hooks.command: cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && (git diff --quiet HEAD -- PROGRESS.md 2>/dev/null && [ -n "$(git status --porcelain -- . ':!PROGRESS.md' 2>/dev/null)" ] && echo '{"systemMessage": "Reminder: PROGRESS.md was not updated this session, but other files changed. Add a short entry so the next session (or teammate) can pick up context."}') || true

input=$(cat); if printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qE 'd1 delete|wrangler delete|--remote.*(DROP|DELETE FROM)|git push.*--force'; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "ask", "permissionDecisionReason": "This touches the single shared production database/Worker or rewrites git history. Confirm the team knows before proceeding."}}'; elif printf '%s' "$input" | grep -qE 'git push|wrangler deploy|d1 migrations apply.*--remote' && [ -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.freeze-at" ] && ! bun "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/scripts/freeze.ts" --check >/dev/null 2>&1; then printf '%s' '{"hookSpecificOutput": {"hookEventName": "PreToolUse", "permissionDecision": "deny", "permissionDecisionReason": "Submission freeze is active (.freeze-at). Pushing or deploying now can disqualify the team."}}'; fi
